title: UAE FTA E-Invoicing & VAT Field Readiness Checks

source_documents.title: UAE Federal Tax Authority — VAT Guide
Peppol PINT-AE Specification (UAE-specific PINT profile, Feb 2026)
UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 47/2022 on Corporate Tax

rules.message: Supplier Tax Registration Number (TRN) is missing or malformed.
rules.fix: Request the supplier's 15-digit TRN and reprint the invoice. Per FTA VAT Guide, every VAT-registered supplier must show TRN on every tax invoice.
rules.citation: FTA VAT Guide — Tax Invoice requirements

rules.message: Buyer TRN is missing for a B2B or intra-GCC invoice.
rules.fix: Capture the buyer's 15-digit TRN. Required for input VAT recovery on B2B supplies and for reverse-charge declarations.
rules.citation: FTA VAT Guide — Reverse Charge & Input VAT Recovery

rules.message: Invoice date is in the future.
rules.fix: Correct the invoice date. The FTA may reject filings where transaction date falls outside the reporting period.
rules.citation: FTA VAT Return Guide — Tax Period Rules

rules.fix: Assign a unique, sequential invoice number. Required for the FTA e-invoicing schema.

rules.message: No itemized line items found (description, quantity, unit price).
rules.fix: Itemize each line: description, quantity, unit price (excluding VAT), VAT rate, VAT amount.

rules.applies_when: bool(extracted.get('line_items')) and extracted.get('vat_rate') is not None
rules.message: Sum of line-level VAT does not match the invoice's stated total VAT.
rules.fix: Recompute VAT per line at the stated rate and reconcile to the printed total. A mismatch is a red flag during FTA audit.
rules.citation: FTA VAT Guide — Calculation of Tax

rules.applies_when: bool(extracted.get('line_items')) and extracted.get('subtotal') is not None
rules.message: Sum of (quantity x unit price) across line items does not match the stated subtotal.
rules.fix: Recompute the subtotal as the sum of each line's quantity times unit price. A mismatch means either a line was misread or the subtotal was misprinted. Reconcile before filing.
rules.citation: FTA VAT Guide — Calculation of Tax

rules.applies_when: bool(extracted.get('line_items')) and extracted.get('vat_amount') is not None
rules.message: Stated VAT total is internally inconsistent with line-level VAT computations.
rules.fix: Verify each line's VAT amount matches (quantity x unit price x rate / 100). The grand total may reconcile but individual lines may be wrong — this is a common hallucination pattern when OCR misreads a single digit.
rules.citation: FTA VAT Guide — Calculation of Tax (per-line)

rules.applies_when: extracted.get('subtotal') is not None and extracted.get('vat_amount') is not None and extracted.get('total') is not None
rules.message: Stated invoice total does not equal subtotal + VAT.
rules.fix: Verify the printed total. It must equal subtotal plus VAT. A mismatch indicates a misread or misprint — recheck the source document before filing.
rules.citation: FTA VAT Guide — Calculation of Tax

rules.message: Reverse-charge declaration is missing or inconsistent with the supply type.
rules.fix: For cross-border B2B services or designated GCC imports, the invoice must clearly state 'Reverse charge applies' and show VAT as 0%.
rules.citation: FTA VAT Guide — Place of Supply & Reverse Charge

rules.message: Invoice is in a currency other than AED.
rules.fix: For UAE domestic supplies, AED is expected. For foreign-currency invoices, ensure the exchange rate used is the FTA-published daily rate for the invoice date.
rules.citation: FTA VAT Guide — Currency & Exchange Rates

rules.message: Corporate tax deductibility marker is missing on the invoice.
rules.fix: While not yet mandatory, tagging the invoice with 'CT-deductible' / 'CT-non-deductible' helps the buyer prepare Federal Decree-Law 47/2022 corporate tax returns. Best practice for UAE Corporate Tax readiness.
rules.citation: UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 47/2022 — Deductible Expenses
